tools.name: mindee_list_models
tools.description: List the document-extraction models available to your Mindee account (id, name, type). Use a model's `id` as the model_id for mindee_extract_document. V2 API: GET /v2/search/models.

tools.name: mindee_get_job
tools.description: Check the processing status of an enqueued document by job id. Status is Waiting | Processing | Processed | Failed. When Processed, the response carries a result_url; pass that inference id to mindee_get_inference. V2 API: GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}.

tools.name: mindee_get_inference
tools.description: Fetch the structured result of a completed inference by id, returned as a compact map of extracted fields (plus raw_text if it was requested). V2 API: GET /v2/inferences/{inference_id}.

tools.name: mindee_extract_document
tools.description: Submit a document (PDF or image) to a Mindee extraction model and return the structured fields. Provide EITHER document_url (a public URL) OR file_base64 (+ filename). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mindee_extract_document · Private data: mindee_list_models, mindee_get_job, mindee_extract_document · Public sink: mindee_extract_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mindee_extract_document · Private data: mindee_list_models, mindee_get_job, mindee_extract_document · Public sink: mindee_extract_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
